lines.zh: 爪子踩雪，一点声音都没有。
lines.en: Paws on snow, not a sound.

lines.zh: 我贴着草丛走，尾巴很低。
lines.en: I slip through the grass, tail low.
Three steps, one pause, listen to the wind.
Pine needles slide under my feet.
By day I walk very slowly.

lines.zh: 我的白毛在雪里看不见。
lines.en: My white fur disappears in the snow.
Along the little path the rabbits made.
My tail brushes the bushes like wind.
I do not take the main road.
My pads are numb with cold, but I keep walking.
Tree shadows shield me from the moon.
I leave little flowers in the snow.
Walk softly, there is a coop ahead.
The sun is too bright; I want to sleep.
I wrap my tail over my nose.
This tree root is a fine place to lie.
My ears turn on their own.

lines.zh: 我听见雪下有东西在动。
lines.en: I hear something moving under the snow.
That sweet berry yesterday was so sweet.
There is fox scent on the wind.
I yawn and show my little fangs.
A pinecone lands on the snow, plop.
I am counting the birds in the tree.
Snow in my fur; I shake it out.
Night is when I belong.
This grove is mine to patrol.
Who trampled the berry bush.

lines.zh: 雪落在洞里，声音闷闷的。
lines.en: Snow falls into the den with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 我把爪子舔干净，慢慢来。
lines.en: I lick my paws clean, slowly.
A crow calls far off; I ignore it.
What is that in your hand, the red thing.
Hold still, let me look at you first.

lines.zh: 你走得这么响，猎物早跑了。
lines.en: You walk so loudly the prey is gone.
Your eyes follow me around.
I tilt my head because I don't understand.
You stand out in the snow.
You smell of chicken.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只是不想靠近。
lines.en: I am not afraid, I simply keep my distance.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的工夫我就能跑掉。
lines.en: I could be gone between your blinks.

lines.zh: 别伸手，先给我看看掌心。
lines.en: Don't reach out; show me your palm first.
Do you also stay awake at night.
I have memorized your boots.
Are you waiting for me to move first.

lines.zh: 白毛在我身上，雪在你身上。
lines.en: White fur on me, snow on you.
You crouch down, and I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 你的影子罩住我，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me. I do not like it.
Yip! That is my tail.

lines.zh: 你打到我了，真的打到我了。
lines.en: You hit me, you really hit me.
A tuft of my fur came out.

lines.zh: 我跑得这么快，还是被打了。
lines.en: I ran so fast and still got hit.
It hurts; I want to hide in the burrow.
I won't bite you, stop hitting.
That one made my legs weak.
My ears are flat against my head.
You are more accurate than a hunter.
I have memorized your scent.

lines.zh: 甜浆果，我闻到甜浆果了。
lines.en: Sweet berries, I smell sweet berries.
Give me one, just one.

lines.zh: 那红色的小东西在发光。
lines.en: That little red thing is glowing.
I could do a flip for you.
Holding the berries high won't help.
My nose is sharper than my eyes.
Not the sour ones, the ripe ones.
Don't tease me, I really will follow.
My tail is wagging already.

lines.zh: 一颗浆果换一条路，行吗。
lines.en: One berry for safe passage, deal?
I can fit one more in my mouth.
Don't wipe the juice off your palm.

lines.zh: 为了浆果，我可以不咬你。
lines.en: For berries, I will not bite you.

lines.zh: 雪下面的尾巴被你踩扁了。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail under the snow.
One bump and I bounce far away.
Don't push me with your knee.
I am this light, and you still collide with me.

lines.zh: 让开，我要从你腿间钻过去。
lines.en: Move, I am slipping between your legs.
I broke through a patch of snow.
You knocked me into the berry bush.

lines.zh: 我身上全是你的味道了。
lines.en: Now I smell entirely of you.
Easy, my bones are slender.
Shoving like two cubs.

lines.zh: 雪地里那只白狐在看我。
lines.en: That white fox in the snow is watching me.
I brought her berries in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我们绕着圈跑，谁也不停。
lines.en: We run in circles and neither stops.
Her tail is whiter than the snow.

lines.zh: 别过来，这是我们的树洞。
lines.en: Stay back, this burrow is ours.

lines.zh: 我给她留了最甜的一颗。
lines.en: I saved the sweetest one for her.

lines.zh: 两个影子在雪上并成一个。
lines.en: Two shadows merge into one on the snow.
In spring there will be kits.
She bit my ear, very gently.

lines.zh: 我们只在这片林子成对。
lines.en: We pair only in this grove.
I carry this meat in my mouth.
What falls on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞得下三颗浆果。
lines.en: My mouth holds three berries.
This feather is lovely.
I will bury it under the snow.
Someone's lost leather; I'll take it.
Running with something in my mouth is my specialty.
This bone will do for my teeth.
I hide it quietly, don't tell anyone.
Sparkly, so it's mine.
That chicken is mine.
The rabbit moved in the snow.
I lower my body, tail straight.
It hasn't heard me.
I have measured the distance: three leaps.
The wind blows toward me, perfect.
I want the fattest one.
The target is small; I must be quick.
My claws are already tucked.
Don't move, just one pounce.
One, two, and then I leap.
I fix my eyes on its neck.
Half a step closer is enough.
The snow is soft; I'll sink on landing.
It looked up; I freeze.
Tail still, or it gives me away.
I circle to the downwind side.
It is running now, perfect.
I count its heartbeat.
Wait until it lowers its head to peck.
I pounce, and then I bite.
My teeth are small but sharp.
Got you, stop struggling.
I practiced this leap all winter.
Feathers are flying everywhere.
I bite, and then I run.
You are much harder to catch than a rabbit.
Paws land first, teeth follow.
Just one bite and I am gone.
Don't blame me, I'm hungry.
I open my eyes inside a snowdrift.
The smell of pine; I know it.
Mother carried me into the burrow.
My fur is still grey.
The world is much bigger than the burrow.

lines.zh: 第一夜，我听见很多声音。
lines.en: My first night, I hear so many sounds.
Snow lands on the tip of my nose.
I shake myself and stand firm.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片林子有我。
lines.en: From today, this grove has me.
It was already dark when I was born.
My fur is singed, what an awful smell.
Fell from the tree; my paws hurt.
Water went up my nose.
A bang, and I flew.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我身边的雪堆里。
lines.en: The arrow buries itself in the snow beside me.
Purple light holds me; I can't run.
My stomach is louder than I am.
The thunder made me jump.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我抓不住。
lines.en: Nothing under my paws, I can't hold on.
